title: Chapter 603 - 603 No Regrets; Strange Jar!
content:
Chapter 603 - 603 No Regrets; Strange Jar!

Chapter 603 - 603 No Regrets; Strange Jar!

603 No Regrets; Strange Jar!

The Heavenly Hound did not seem to notice the change in Hashimoto Musashi, and its sharp claws continued to strike down without any pause.

A loud sound like metal clashing echoed throughout the scene.

Then, Hashimoto Musashi felt himself falling.

He saw his bronze skin and the metal bones in his body…

His upper body was actually neatly separated from his lower body!

In the next moment, Hashimoto Musashi’s two halves landed heavily on the ground with a dull thud.

Hashimoto Musashi had always wanted to see what his bones had become after he obtained Copper Skin Iron Bones.

Now, it had finally become reality.

He… He could have no regrets!

It was also at this moment that Hashimoto Musashi’s skill disappeared and his body returned to its original state.

Hot blood spurted out like a fountain.

Fortunately, the Heavenly Hound was fast, so its fur was not stained by the blood.

At this moment, an emotionless voice sounded in the ears of everyone in Japes.

[Hashimoto Musashi has died. The area of Japes has been reduced by 10%.]

…

Earth.

The Void Gate floating in the sky above Japes suddenly emitted wisps of black gas.

A huge wave crashed over from afar, instantly drowning the land that had been added not long ago.

At the same time, it also swallowed some of the buildings by the sea and the people who were playing.

In the live broadcast room.

The originally quiet livestream room began to become noisy after the sound in their ears.

Kitaoka: [Hashimoto is dead…]

Taro Oban: [This… This is not true.]

Cheese: [No!]

…

This video was quickly sent to Corea.

Originally, they were full of confidence in the Corean hero, Li Jinxuan. They were looking forward to him meeting a ferocious beast or Lin Fan.

From there, he could kill beasts and obtain more treasure chests or kill Lin Fan to avenge Li Xianhao.

However, at this moment, all the Coreans fell silent.

They prayed silently in their hearts that Li Jinxuan would not encounter a ferocious beast, let alone Lin Fan.

The other party… was simply too powerful.

Perhaps the prayers of the people from Corea had an effect.

Li Jinxuan indeed did not meet Lin Fan or any ferocious beasts.

However, he encountered many ceramic jars.

After Li Jinxuan arrived at the forbidden area, he appeared very calm.

He had obtained 500 Constitution points, so he felt that he was filled with endless strength. It was as if he had become Superman!

At this moment, Li Jinxuan felt that even if he faced a ferocious beast, he did not have to be afraid at all.

He first looked around and found that there were tall trees around him. There was nothing different.

Therefore, Li Jinxuan casually found a direction and strode forward.

He walked past the big trees and through the grass…

Many ancient ceramic jars with human faces engraved on them appeared in front of him.

“What are these things?” Li Jinxuan said lightly.

“Could there be something inside?”

Li Jinxuan’s mind began to work.

He had once seen some movies where there would be some treasures in jars. In fact, the jars themselves were treasures.

Even though he was currently in the Otherworld…

Li Jinxuan felt that he would return to Earth one day.

At that time, these jars… and the things inside…

Thinking of this, Li Jinxuan walked forward to the mouth of a jar and prepared to investigate.

Just as he approached…

A crack appeared on one of the jars.

Then, black mucus flew out like an arrow and wrapped around Li Jinxuan.

Li Jinxuan was shocked and hurriedly struggled.

However, the amount of black mucus was increasing.

Soon, it completely enveloped Li Jinxuan.

Suddenly, the audience only saw a black thing that kept twisting.

A moment later, the black sticky liquid flew back into the jar.

However, Li Jinxuan had disappeared.

He… melted!

At the same time, an emotionless voice sounded in everyone’s ears.

[Li Jinxuan’s death will reduce the lifespan of Coreans by one year.]

A ball of black gas spread out from the Void Gate.

Suddenly, a driver’s heart stopped, causing an accident.

A lecturer suddenly fell from the podium and stopped breathing.

The person who was drinking suddenly choked and spat out a large mouthful of blood.

…

In the live broadcast room of Corea.

Li Oppa: [What exactly is that thing?]

Xuan Fan: [No! Li Jinxuan won’t die.]

Seunmida: [It’s too scary.]

Fans: [No!]

…

Hashimoto Musashi’s death was just a small matter to Lin Fan.

As for Li Jinxuan’s death, Lin Fan had no idea at all.

As usual, he walked forward unhurriedly.

…

Abraham, one of the heroes of Bear Country, was also in the forest of the level-eight forbidden area.

After opening the golden treasure chest, he had obtained 400 Constitution points, which gave him tyrannical strength.

At this moment, a three-meter-tall golden-furred bear stood in front of Abraham.

Abraham was nearly 1.9 meters tall.

However, he was still like a dwarf in front of the giant bear.

Even so, Abraham was not afraid.

On the contrary, he seemed very happy and said in his native language, “Yo! Bear! My country is called Bear Country! It’s the country that gets along the best with bears!

“However, most of the bears in our world are gray.”

The giant bear did not understand Abraham’s words at all. It looked up and roared.

Then, it waved its ferocious claws and slapped down on Abraham.

Abraham’s expression changed slightly, and he quickly flashed behind a big tree.

The terrifying power of the giant golden bear even caused the entire tree to tremble.

However, Abraham was not afraid.

“You attacked just now. Now, it’s my turn!” He laughed excitedly.

As soon as he finished speaking, Abraham jumped up, raised his fist, gathered his strength, and smashed it toward the giant golden bear’s chest.

The sound of something breaking through the air rang out.

The giant golden bear’s huge body was sent flying several meters away.

The strength of 400 Constitution points was so tyrannical.

However, this did not cause fatal damage to the giant golden bear. It only broke a few of its bones.

A trace of blood seeped out from the corner of the giant golden bear’s mouth.

It was injured!

It was injured by a weak worm!

The giant golden bear was completely enraged.

It roared at the sky and rushed toward Abraham like a speeding truck. It waved its claws and slapped Abraham again.

Abraham dodged to the side again.

The big tree in front of him fell down.

The giant golden bear’s angry claws were so powerful!
